title: Jeska Closes the Zhalfirin Rift
summary: A dangerous fracture is closed, but Teferi's remaining route to Zhalfir is cut off.
narrative: Jeska tried to repair the damage to Dominaria while relying upon others' connections to the rifts.
Closing the Zhalfirin wound preserved reality but eliminated the route through which Teferi hoped to recover the phased-out homeland.
